title: 눈물이 만들어지고 빠지는 길
alt: 눈물샘과 위아래 눈물점, 눈물소관, 눈물주머니, 코눈물관을 a부터 g로 표시한 그림
caption: a는 눈물샘, b·e는 위·아래 눈물점, c·f는 눈물소관, d는 눈물주머니, g는 코눈물관입니다. 눈물은 눈 표면을 적신 뒤 눈물점을 통해 코 쪽으로 배출됩니다.

changes: 원본 SVG의 Wikimedia 제공 PNG 렌더링 사용; 그림 내용 변경 없음.

metadataEvidence.artist:
Since FML's vector image was broken, Erin_Silversmith took the bitmap version and vectorised it.  The labels in Portuguese were replaced with letters, for internationalisation purposes. (The iris was redone in the second revision of this image, based on the photograph Image:Iris.eye.225px.jpg (automatically vectorised using Delineate).  However, in the fifth revision, this was then replaced by a spoke-like design based on the original GIF.) To the right, there is an example of how the diagram can be used in an article.
Note how the diagram is neat, and the labels can be Wikilinks. If a version with labels in a certain language is deemed necessary, it should be uploaded with the language suffix i.e. Tear system xx.svg where xx is the language code.
metadataEvidence.credit: Based on excellent images created by User:FML and uploaded to Commons as Sistema lacrimal.gif and Sistema lacrimal.svg .
metadataEvidence.description: English: Tear system: a. tear gland / lacrimal gland, b. superior lacrimal punctum, c. superior lacrimal canal, d. tear sac / lacrimal sac, e. inferior lacrimal punctum, f. inferior lacrimal canal, g. nasolacrimal canal Français : Le système lacrymal: a : Glande lacrymale b : Point supérieur lacrymal c : Canal lacrymal supérieur d : Sac lacrymal e : Point lacrymal inférieur f : Canal lacrymal inférieur g : Canal nasolacrymal Polski: Narząd łzowy Português: O sistema lacrimal a. glândula lacrimal b. ponto lacrimal superior c. canalículo superior d. saco lacrimal e. ponto lacrimal inferior f. canalículo inferior g. canal lácrimo-nasal
